task_group.description: Optional few-word code work area for the active task. This is a broad implementation domain, not a specific task detail, progress report, completion summary, or user-visible reply. Correct examples: PDF editing, storefront frontend, order settlement service. Wrong examples: Create a slide deck about the fall of Constantinople in 1453, Add cart button animation, Check order system logs.

status.description: Update only when there is a real task-state transition. doing only when more command_run calls are required; question when blocked on user feedback; done only when assigned work is complete, executor-owned verification has passed, and any media to send/show has been read and inspected. Verification defaults to this executor; explicitly parent-owned checks remain pending and are not a worker completion requirement. Missing tools alone do not transfer verification ownership.

task_type.description: Complete set of prompt and Operation Manual types needed by the current task. Update it as soon as the task type is identified, keep it paired with task_group, and include multiple ids when multiple manuals apply. Runtime injects the current available task types from runtime prompt identities.

final_reply.description: Complete answer as unchanged text or compact JSON object/array. Status done, observed executor-owned checks, no compact_context; or status question carrying the complete question or blocker, so no further turn is needed. A pre-authored reply may instead follow fully-known mechanical work as the sole command in a strictly later final step, only after every earlier result succeeds and with no earlier task_status or compact_context; failed, cancelled, unknown or ambiguous results forbid delivery. Output-dependent conclusions require another model turn. Report explicitly parent-owned checks as pending, never passed; worker delivery is not overall acceptance. Omission retains normal assistant delivery.

compact_context.description: Replaces the model's active working context with a handoff summary; not a status or notes field. Omit for routine progress, recording plans or decision fields, a failed read, or a phase transition while the same task still needs its current source context. Use only for actual context pressure or a genuine task handoff where earlier context can be discarded. Preserve the unresolved task, exact evidence references, and necessary source context.
